tools.name: shop_vehicles
tools.description: Use for live US/CA cars/SUVs/trucks/EVs/motorcycles/RVs/trailers by place (near me), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel, features, named dealer, or live-listing recommendation. Quebec excluded. Call once; never retry/refine/broaden. Fallback stays in-country; filters exact. Facts onl

tools.name: get_vehicle
tools.description: For full detail, pass exact shop_vehicles listing_id; returns dealer.dealer_id.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Citation only; never shopping/detail/compare. Search once, then fetch exact IDs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Citation only after search; never shopping/detail. Fetch one exact ID.

tools.name: compare_vehicles
tools.description: Only for explicit comparison: after exactly one shop_vehicles call, pass 2-4 distinct returned listing IDs. Never search or shop again.

tools.name: find_dealerships
tools.description: Use this once to find dealerships by name/place with IDs, addresses, and listing counts. Named stock: one shop_vehicles call with a returned dealer_id. For contacts or sales/service hours: get_dealership once.

tools.name: get_dealership
tools.description: Use this with an exact dealer_id to return every public rooftop, contact, site, capability, and named sales/service schedule.

tools.name: schedule_test_drive
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, request a test drive for this listing.

tools.name: request_trade_in_appraisal
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, request a trade-in appraisal for this listing.

tools.name: submit_vehicle_inquiry
tools.description: After explicit consent and confirmation, send this listing's dealer a question.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search · Private data: find_dealerships, get_dealership · Public sink: submit_vehicle_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search · Private data: find_dealerships, get_dealership · Public sink: submit_vehicle_inquiry

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "shop_vehicles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use for live US/CA cars/SUVs/trucks/EVs/motorcycles/RVs/trailers by place (near me), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel, features, named dealer, or live-listing recommendation. Quebec excluded. Call once; never retry/refine/broaden. Fallback stays in-country; filters exact. Facts onl" → after: "Search and rank participating US/Canadian dealer cars, SUVs, trucks, EVs, motorcycles, RVs and trailers by place (including near me), budget, mileage, make/model, condition, body, fuel and features. Quebec excluded. Accepts the shopper’s wording and optional structured filters. Named-dealer stock us"

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
